# TheFixer — Software, Hardware & Design. If it’s broken, consider it fixed.

> Software, hardware and design: repair, custom firmware, on-premises AI and premium templates for trades and creators. If it’s broken, consider it fixed.

No sign-up.

Play and download free, no sign-up.

Print or save as PDF. No sign-up.
